name: week
title: Returns desk: the week
subtitle: Internal review. Receipt and remedy records require human evidence.

sections.title: Queue
sections.sql: select code,customer,owner,due,status,awaiting_receipt,awaiting_inspection,undecided,awaiting_completion from return_queue order by due,code

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by case_code,code,rule

sections.title: Waiting for inspection
sections.sql: select code,case_code,sku,received,inspected,received-inspected as outstanding from item_balance where case_status='open' and received>inspected order by code

sections.title: Disposition evidence
sections.sql: select i.code,i.sku,x.quantity,x.grade,x.disposition,x.evidence from inspections x join items i on i.id=x.item_id order by i.code

sections.title: Reasons by product
sections.sql: select * from reason_summary order by units desc,sku

sections.title: Resolution progress
sections.sql: select code,sku,currency,remedy,amount_cents,attention from decision_queue order by code
